Name: Goat Girl Abigail
Author: YukoValis
Description:
It was getting a bit lonely with only the Hucows in the barn.  So I decided to apply a few more leather straps to the situation, and turn Abigail into a lovely lil goat girl.  She certainly is a bit more feisty then the cows.

This mod didn't take as long as the others because I already had most of it done.  Maybe 6 hours?  That isn't to say I was cheap about it.  Instead of doing the lazy thing and changing out sprites, I redesigned her quite a lot.  You might also notice a bit more playful pose in there.  Well maybe it is playful, it could be considered rude.  I chose Abigail for the goat cause something something dark magic, seemed to fit.   After that it is sheep,  can you guess who will get the role? :)

NOTE: Nothing has changed with this sprite since 1.3, so it should still work.
